HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsContainerSizeHint: Size of each heart container. Default is 10 hit points per heart.
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsEnableHeartContainersHint: Show the heart containers in the UI when you have a character assigned to your user.
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsFontAwesomeIconHint: The icon used for the 'hearts'. The default is 'fa-heart'. Note that not all icons should have an 'empty' equivalent. You can browse free icons here: https://fontawesome.com/search?ic=free-collection
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsPathNameMaxHint: The data path to the maximum hit points on actors.
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsPathNameTempHint: The data path to the temporary hit points on actors. Shown in blue.
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsPathNameTempmaxHint: The data path to a value that increases the maximum hit points on actors. Shown in yellow.
HEART_CONTAINERS.SettingsPathNameValueHint: The data path to the current hit points on actors. Shown in red.
